title: Metaorder modelling and identification from public data
abstract: arXiv:2608.30999v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Market-order flow in financial markets exhibits long-range correlations. This is a widely known stylised fact of financial markets. A popular hypothesis for this stylised fact comes from the Lillo-Mike-Farmer (LMF) order-splitting theory. However, quantitative tests of this theory have historically relied on proprietary datasets with trader identifiers, limiting reproducibility and cross-market validation. We investigate whether it can be recovered from anonymous public data using synthetic metaorder reconstruction. Using transaction and quote data for the largest 239 stocks by market capitalisation on the JSE as of 13 March 2026 with the data range being 1 January 2023 until 31 December 2025, we conduct a grid search over reconstruction parameters and evaluate each configuration against established metaorder stylised facts and the LMF relation. translated_title: 基于公开数据的母订单建模与识别
translated_abstract: 金融市场中的市价订单流呈现出长程相关性，这是金融市场一个广为人知的典型事实。对这一典型事实的一个流行解释假说来自Lillo-Mike-Farmer（LMF）订单拆分理论。然而，对该理论的定量检验历来依赖于带有交易者标识符的专有数据集，这限制了研究的可重复性和跨市场验证。我们研究了能否通过合成母订单重构方法从匿名公开数据中恢复这一理论。我们使用截至2026年3月13日约翰内斯堡证券交易所（JSE）市值最大的239只股票的交易与报价数据（数据范围为2023年1月1日至2025年12月31日），对重构参数进行了网格搜索，并依据已确立的母订单典型事实和LMF关系对每种参数配置进行评估。选择在母订单冲击典型事实上误差最小的配置，可再现……
tldr: 该研究提出一种从匿名公开交易数据中重构合成母订单的方法，通过网格搜索参数并依据母订单冲击典型事实进行评估，证明了Lillo-Mike-Farmer订单拆分理论无需依赖带交易者标识的专有数据即可从公开数据中恢复。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a synthetic metaorder reconstruction method from anonymous public trading data, showing through grid search and evaluation against metaorder impact stylised facts that the Lillo-Mike-Farmer order-splitting theory can be recovered without proprietary trader-identified datasets.
